title: template.massupdate
description: Simultaneously replace or remove related objects and update properties on multiple templates.

templates.description: Templates to be updated. The templates must have only the templateid property defined. Parameter behavior: required.

groups.description: Template groups to replace the current template groups the templates belong to. The template groups must have only the groupid property defined.

macros.description: User macros to replace all of the current user macros on the given templates. See the User macro object (reference/usermacro/object).

templates_clear.description: Templates to unlink and clear from the given templates. The templates must have only the templateid property defined.

templates_link.description: Templates to replace the currently linked templates. The templates must have only the templateid property defined.

templateGroupRef.description: Reference to an existing template group by groupid only.

templateRef.description: Reference to an existing template by templateid only.
